description: This file defines data models using Pydantic for a claim verification platform, including user authentication, claim management, source analysis, and metrics.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Model for user registration request with email and password.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Model representing user profile details including id, email, roles, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Model for user login request with email and password.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Model for JWT token response including token, type, and expiry.

classes.name: ClaimCreateRequest
classes.description: Model for creating a claim with text and optional metadata.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: Model representing a source related to a claim, including id, title, url, snippet, reliability, stance, provider, and fetch time.

classes.name: AnalysisSummary
classes.description: Model summarizing analysis results for a claim, including id, claim id, summary, score, and creation time.

classes.name: ClaimStatus
classes.description: Model representing the processing status of a claim with status, progress, and stage.

classes.name: ClaimItem
classes.description: Model representing a claim with id, text, status, user id, timestamps, sources, and optional analysis.

classes.name: ClaimListResponse
classes.description: Model for paginated list of claims including items, total, page, and size.

classes.name: CreateClaimResponse
classes.description: Model for response after creating a claim, including id, initial status, and job id.

classes.name: MetricsSummaryResponse
classes.description: Model summarizing metrics such as total claims, average score, latency percentiles, and success rate.
